modules.name: Visitors (Mobile)
modules.description: Mobile functions for recording expected visitors and walk-ins, and for the Watchman to view and manage visitor entry and exit.

requirements.title: Add expected visitor
requirements.description: A visitor added for today appears in the Watchman's list with a pass code.

requirements.title: Today's visitor list for Watchman
requirements.description: On Watchman login, only today's visitors of the Watchman's own project are shown, searchable by name, mobile and pass code.

requirements.title: Walk-in entry, record only
requirements.description: When there is no advance entry and the Watchman adds details, the visit is saved at once with no approval, and the resident gets an information notification.

requirements.title: Call resident
requirements.description: For a walk-in, when the Watchman taps Call, the flat's main user is called. Priority is Should.

requirements.title: Record entry and exit time
requirements.description: The system records visitor entry and exit time. A visit with no exit by midnight is marked Exit Not Recorded.

requirements.title: Weak network support
requirements.description: With no network, up to 50 entries are saved on the phone and sent later. Priority is Should.

requirements.title: Simple Watchman screen
requirements.description: Any entry must take 3 taps or fewer.

requirements.title: Watchman login management
requirements.description: The system supports management of Watchman logins.
